title: Ternary Operator Overuse
pattern: Nesting ternary or inline `if-else` operators within other inline operators.
why_bad: Obscures the logic completely. The reader is forced to parse multi-line expressions containing complex logical conditions in a single sentence.
detection: Multi-level nested ternary expressions or inline `if` statements.
counterexample: A single-level, clean inline ternary mapping (e.g., `let val = if cond { 1 } else { 0 };`).
fix: Expand to structured `if-else` blocks or match expressions.
source: Trevor Foucher & Dustin Boswell, *The Art of Readable Code*, Chapter 7.
